prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet companion to roam, play, and assist directly on your desktop screen.", "Playful Puppy Preview", "Curious Kitten Preview"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn quick mouse shortcuts to control, hide, or chat with your desktop pet anytime.", "Got It, Launch Pet!", "Drag to move around desktop screen", "Right click for pet menu & hide option", "Double click to start voice chat"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your adoption certificate and sync your pet across all your devices."]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Pick an existing companion ready to adopt or create a custom pet from your own photo.", "Instant Pet Adoption", "Choose from cute ready-made desktop pets in seconds.", "Custom Pet Creator", "Upload photos to generate a unique 3D desktop companion."]
4: ["Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to summon your pet to the active window!"]
5: ["For best 3D results, use well-lit front-facing photos with clear background contrast.", "Clear front photos guarantee accurate pet animation and color matching."]
6: ["Secure Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "Signing in automatically backs up your pet's memory, items, and settings so your companion is never lost."]
7: ["Includes Free Starter Toy Pack"]
8: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Look at your desktop! Your pet is waiting for its first interaction.", "Start Playing Now"]
9: ["We will notify you in the desktop system tray when your pet needs attention."]
